# Drains

> Drains is a local-first engineering log. A drain is a running log
> channel — one per project, incident, or team — that entries flow
> into from multiple sources: people, GitHub, AI summaries, and
> MCP-connected agents.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://drains.dev/docs): what a drain is, core concepts
- [Getting started](https://drains.dev/docs/getting-started): identity, drains, entries
- [Connecting an agent](https://drains.dev/docs/mcp): MCP setup and available tools
- [API tokens](https://drains.dev/docs/api): agent/API token reference

## For agents

- [AGENTS.md](https://drains.dev/AGENTS.md): how an AI agent connects via MCP,
  what it can read and write, and how attribution works.
